# Does your medical bill charge you twice for the same thing?

> Free tool for patients: paste or drop your itemized medical bill and see possible duplicate charges, codes billed twice in a day, unbundled lab panels, two visit levels on one date and lines that do not add up, with a draft request to send the billing office. Runs in your browser, the bill is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
